sentences.pinyin: Tā de gèzi hěn gāo.
sentences.english: He is very tall.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei de gèzi bǐ wǒ ǎi.
sentences.english: My younger sister is shorter than me.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gēn péngyou yìqǐ qù gōngyuán.
sentences.english: I go to the park with friends.

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ gēn wǒ shuōshuo zhè jiàn shì.
sentences.english: Tell me about this matter.

sentences.chinese: 根据天气预报，明天会下雨。
sentences.pinyin: Gēnjù tiānqì yùbào, míngtiān huì xià yǔ.
sentences.english: According to the weather forecast, it will rain tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 根据老师的要求，我们完成了作业。
sentences.pinyin: Gēnjù lǎoshī de yāoqiú, wǒmen wánchéngle zuòyè.
sentences.english: We finished the homework according to the teacher's requirements.

sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān bǐ zuótiān gèng rè.
sentences.english: Today is hotter than yesterday.

sentences.pinyin: Tā bǐ wǒ gèng xǐhuan yùndòng.
sentences.english: He likes sport more than I do.

sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiāngzi yǒu shí gōngjīn zhòng.
sentences.english: This box weighs ten kilograms.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ mǎile liǎng gōngjīn píngguǒ.
sentences.english: I bought two kilograms of apples.

sentences.chinese: 我们每天早上去公园散步。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen měitiān zǎoshang qù gōngyuán sànbù.
sentences.english: We go for a walk in the park every morning.

sentences.pinyin: Zhège gōngyuán lǐ yǒu hěn duō shù.
sentences.english: There are a lot of trees in this park.

sentences.chinese: 妈妈每天晚上给我讲故事。
sentences.pinyin: Māma měitiān wǎnshang gěi wǒ jiǎng gùshi.
sentences.english: Mum tells me a story every evening.

sentences.pinyin: Zhège gùshi hěn yǒu yìsi.
sentences.english: This story is very interesting.

sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān wàimiàn guāfēng le.
sentences.english: It has turned windy outside today.

sentences.pinyin: Guāfēng de shíhou bié kāi chuānghu.
sentences.english: Do not open the window when it is windy.

sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ mén guānshàng.
sentences.english: Please close the door.

sentences.pinyin: Zǒu de shíhou jìde guān dēng.
sentences.english: Remember to turn off the light when you leave.

sentences.chinese: 他们两个人的关系很好。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen liǎng ge rén de guānxì hěn hǎo.
sentences.english: The two of them get on very well.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì gēn wǒ méiyǒu guānxì.
sentences.english: This matter has nothing to do with me.

sentences.pinyin: Māma hěn guānxīn wǒ de shēntǐ.
sentences.english: Mum cares a great deal about my health.

sentences.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ guānxīn wǒ.
sentences.english: Thank you for your concern.

sentences.chinese: 这本书是关于中国历史的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū shì guānyú Zhōngguó lìshǐ de.
sentences.english: This book is about Chinese history.

sentences.chinese: 我们谈了关于工作的事情。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen tánle guānyú gōngzuò de shìqing.
sentences.english: We talked about matters to do with work.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ qùguo hěn duō guójiā.
sentences.english: I have been to many countries.

sentences.chinese: 每个国家都有自己的文化。
sentences.pinyin: Měi ge guójiā dōu yǒu zìjǐ de wénhuà.
sentences.english: Every country has its own culture.

sentences.pinyin: Guòqù de shìqing bié zài xiǎng le.
sentences.english: Stop thinking about things that are past.

sentences.pinyin: Guòqù wǒ zài zhèlǐ gōngzuò.
sentences.english: I used to work here.

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ hē chá háishì hē kāfēi?
sentences.english: Would you like tea or coffee?

sentences.chinese: 下雨了，我们还是坐车去吧。
sentences.pinyin: Xià yǔ le, wǒmen háishì zuò chē qù ba.
sentences.english: It is raining — let us take a car after all.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei hěn hàipà gǒu.
sentences.english: My younger sister is very afraid of dogs.

sentences.pinyin: Bié hàipà, wǒ zài zhèr.
sentences.english: Do not be afraid — I am right here.

sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī zài hēibǎn shàng xiě zì.
sentences.english: The teacher writes on the blackboard.

sentences.pinyin: Qǐng kàn hēibǎn shàng de tí.
sentences.english: Please look at the question on the blackboard.

sentences.pinyin: Hòulái tā bāndàole Běijīng.
sentences.english: Later he moved to Beijing.

sentences.chinese: 我开始不认识他，后来我们成了朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kāishǐ bù rènshi tā, hòulái wǒmen chéngle péngyou.
sentences.english: At first I did not know him; later we became friends.

sentences.pinyin: Chū guó yào dài hùzhào.
sentences.english: You need to take your passport to go abroad.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de hùzhào fàng zài bāo lǐ le.
sentences.english: I have put my passport in the bag.

sentences.pinyin: Qiáng shàng yǒu yì fú piàoliang de huà.
sentences.english: There is a beautiful painting on the wall.

sentences.pinyin: Tā xǐhuan huà shān hé shuǐ.
sentences.english: He likes to paint mountains and water.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de shǒubiǎo huài le.
sentences.english: My watch is broken.

sentences.pinyin: Bié chī huàile de shuǐguǒ.
sentences.english: Do not eat fruit that has gone bad.

sentences.pinyin: Huānyíng nǐ lái wǒ jiā.
sentences.english: Welcome to my home.

sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī huānyíng dàjiā tí wèntí.
sentences.english: The teacher welcomes questions from everyone.

sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de huánjìng hěn ānjìng.
sentences.english: It is very quiet here.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yào bǎohù huánjìng.
sentences.english: We should protect the environment.

sentences.chinese: 我想换一个大一点儿的房子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng huàn yí ge dà yìdiǎnr de fángzi.
sentences.english: I would like to move to a slightly bigger house.

sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bāng wǒ huàn yíxià qián.
sentences.english: Please help me change some money.

sentences.chinese: 黄河是中国第二长的河。
sentences.pinyin: Huánghé shì Zhōngguó dì-èr cháng de hé.
sentences.english: The Yellow River is China's second longest river.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen qù kànle Huánghé.
sentences.english: We went to see the Yellow River.
